stories.title: Geothermal Utilities Power Wave of US Affordable Housing with 40% Energy Savings
stories.label: technology
stories.summary: A gas utility in Vermont just did something no utility had done before: it built a community-scale geothermal system to heat and cool homes instead of burning fuel. The project is already up and running, and it's cutting energy bills by about 40 percent for the people living there. Because it's run through the existing utility, this model could spread to other towns without residents needing to pay for their own new systems. It's a real, working example of cheaper, cleaner energy reaching everyday people, not just a plan on paper.
stories.why_good: A geothermal energy deal that actually happened and is already cutting real people's utility bills by 40%, with a scalable model for more communities.

stories.title: People Around the World Help Buy Royal Estate for Wildlife Conservation
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: A huge stretch of wild land that had belonged to British nobility for generations is now protected for good, thanks to ordinary people chipping in. Donors from all over the world pooled millions of dollars to buy the estate and turn it over to conservation. The land is home to curlews, lapwings, mountain bumblebees, and other wading birds that need wide open space to survive. It's a reminder that when enough people care about the same patch of earth, they can actually buy its safety. No government mandate needed, just a lot of people saying yes.
stories.why_good: A real purchase, already completed, that permanently protects biodiverse habitat through voluntary global generosity rather than any political fight.
